reason: The approved scope and supplier arguments support the batch’s conditional claims. I found page-local gaps in regularity, variation classes, force-field typing, and example domains that can be repaired within this batch.

findings.reason: Specify the initial parameter and solution domain, for example s0 with x(s0)=p0 and U(s0)=U0. “Through it” omits the time-coordinate data of the IVP.

State the clock curve’s domain and regularity. The linked GR definition permits piecewise-C1 future-timelike curves, but the RPM definition’s massive worldline is C2 and the assigned reunion path has a corner. Explicitly adopt the piecewise class and its segment-integral rule, or use a smooth path.

A C1 reparametrization need not preserve the C2 path class, and the stationarity derivative may then be undefined. Separate integral-value invariance from equation covariance, requiring enough regularity for the latter.
Specify a finite parameter segment and the exact curve and fixed-endpoint variation class for the action; the local first-variation lemma supplies one such class. State m’s SI unit explicitly.

A C1 reparametrization can take a C2 curve and smooth einbein outside the stated configuration class. Restrict the invariance claim to class-preserving transformations or explicitly extend the action domain.
State the action’s finite interval, curve and einbein regularity, and independent variation classes as in the cited lemma. Its C1 gauge claim also need not preserve that configuration class.

Define the force map explicitly: an open V subset of TM and a smooth f:V to TM with f(p,V) in T_pM, and state orthogonality on that domain. The shell-tangent IVP supplier gives this exact formulation.
Specify the parameter domain of the cylinder curve, for example gamma:R to M_L.
Name the inertial chart and make the four-dimensional path coordinates explicit; the displayed paths currently give only two components. State that the other spatial coordinates vanish.
Specify x:I to M for a nonempty open parameter interval I and the rescaled parameter domain I/a.
Specify the parameter domain of x, such as tau in R, and state p is in A and U0 in its displacement space V.
